daily.today_energy: Your emotional radar is *chef's kiss* today. Trust those gut feelings—they're basically your superpower right now. The universe is giving soft, grounded vibes that want you to slow down and actually feel things.
daily.love: Someone's been thinking about you more than you realize. Whether it's potential romance or deepening a current connection, vulnerability is your hottest trait today. Let people see the real you.
daily.career: Your creative problem-solving is hitting different. That idea you've been sitting on? Today's the day to actually voice it. Your colleagues are ready to hear what you've got, and the timing feels right.
daily.health: Your body's asking for gentleness today. Whether that's a longer shower, stretching, or just saying no to one thing—honor what feels nourishing. Mental clarity follows when you listen to what you physically need.

weekly.overview: This week, your intuition is basically your cheat code. The cosmos wants you to trust those gut feelings that have been whispering to you. Something's shifting in your favor, even if it doesn't look obvious yet. Lean into the mystery.
weekly.love: Whether you're coupled up or single, vulnerability is your superpower right now. Let people see the real, messy version of you. The right energy will match it. Stop performing and start connecting.
